name: list_peers
description: List peers in the Loom room (name, agent, id, online/offline).

name: handoff
description: Send a message/task to another peer (@name, id, or *). Works even if target is offline (queued in their inbox). Returns status queued|delivered|peer_unknown. Optional withPack attaches local room context pack (summary/paths/notes). withPackEmbed also embeds file bodies (L-5; re-resolves allowlist at send).

withPack.description: Attach local context pack as handoff attachments

withPackEmbed.description: L-5: embed file bodies for pack paths (implies withPack; allowlist re-checked at send)

withBoard.description: Attach local task board snapshot (multi-machine share; receiver import_board or loom board import-handoff)

trackBoard.description: Also create a room task board item linked to this handoff (default true when mode=task)

name: get_context_pack
description: Read the local room context pack (summary, cwd-relative paths, notes). Pack is local until attached via handoff withPack.

name: get_purpose
description: Read the local room purpose card (purpose, success criteria, out-of-scope, verify recipes). Room-scoped on this machine.

name: set_purpose
description: Update room purpose / successCriteria / outOfScope / notes. Cannot set verify[] (M-24 — use CLI loom purpose set --verify). Same UID residual as board.

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks on the local room task board (todo/doing/done/blocked/cancelled). Room-scoped on this machine.

name: add_task
description: Add a task to the local room board. Optional notify=true sends handoff to assignee (L-32: default false).

notify.description: If true, handoff [GOAL] to assignee (default false)

name: update_task
description: Update task status, assignee, title, or notes by id.

name: export_board
description: Export the local room task board as a portable snapshot (JSON). Use for multi-machine share.

name: import_board
description: Import a board snapshot into the current room board. mode=merge (default) or replace. force=true if sourceRoomId differs.

force.description: Allow import when sourceRoomId ≠ current room

name: room_chat
description: Send a short chat message to the room.

name: check_handoffs
description: List queued/notified handoffs in your inbox. Poll this to receive work from other peers/agents.

name: claim_handoff
description: Claim a handoff by id from your inbox (first-wins vs human accept). Returns full body to act on.

name: dispatch_card
description: Dispatch an existing board card to a remote herdr node bridge. Sends a mode:task handoff with a loom-card-dispatch attachment, then moves the card to doing with assignee/handoffId set.

taskId.description: Board task id (task_<hex>; unique suffix accepted)

node.description: Target bridge peer displayName, e.g. node/wsl-1

prompt.description: Literal prompt text injected into the remote agent (no trailing newline)

agentKind.description: Agent kind from the dispatch allowlist: claude|codex|grok (default "claude"). Not an argv — mapping lives in bridge-local config; unregistered kinds fail closed.

name: apply_card_result
description: Apply a claimed card result (loom-card-result attachment JSON) to the local board under remote-result isolation: every accepted remote result maps to blocked (never board done); legacy status "done" records reason legacy_remote_done_requires_verification; failed stays blocked with its reason; summary → notes. Board done requires an explicit local mutation after verification. Pass fromPeerId/fromNode from the claimed handoff for L-2 forgery checks.

resultJson.description: Raw content of the loom-card-result attachment from the claimed handoff

fromNode.description: Claimed sender displayName / node for L-2 assignee match

name: conv_open
description: Open a multiturn conv (§CONV_SPEC) with a remote peer: sends conv.open, pins the peer for the conv's lifetime, and creates a linked board card (doing). node = target bridge peer displayName.

goal.description: Conv goal — doubles as the worker's first-turn prompt

cwd.description: Optional scope cwd (fixed at open, no mid-conv renegotiation)

agentKind.description: Worker agent kind: claude|codex|grok (default "claude"). Spawn requires the bridge node to have locally registered argv for that kind (fail-closed otherwise).

name: conv_send
description: Send a turn on an open conv (tower or worker side, per role). text over 32,000 chars requires artifacts[] (§5.1 — no truncation).

name: conv_await
description: Block until the next conv intent (accept/reject/turn) arrives, or timeoutSec elapses. Reuses check/claim internally (M-6 unchanged) — no separate conv_apply. When a turn carries artifacts[] (§5.1 32k overflow), the result also includes artifactCommands[] — one presented (validated, POSIX-quoted, never executed) fetch command per artifact ref, or a fail-closed reason (e.g. no local scp host mapping — R26 M-1/M-2). Review before running.

name: conv_close
description: Tower-only, unilateral close (§1.4/§3.2). reason=done|abort (default done). Closes locally even if delivery to the peer fails.

name: conv_fetch
description: PLAN 0.25.0: retrieve a conv scp artifact by coordinate (convId, seq, index). Host/path/sha are resolved from server-side stored turn artifacts (never from caller). Spawns scp with argv directly (no shell), re-validates host/path exec-path, writes under ~/.loom/artifacts/<convId>/, verifies sha256. Returns metadata only (argv, destPath, sha256, bytes) — not file contents. Git transport refs are present-only (not fetchable). Overwrite of an existing local file is rejected.

convId.description: Conv id that owns the turn

seq.description: Turn sequence number that carried the artifact ref

index.description: Index into that turn's artifacts[] array
